Improve faster with the Resolution Learning Loop™

Link service to the rest of your business
Make smarter decisions faster with AI
Get a unified view of service data
Take total control of your service
How can we help? Contact us.

body: Real resolutions, not just deflection

Our Resolution Platform is built for faster, more effective outcomes. It seamlessly pulls your technology into a unified service ecosystem, empowering AI to connect data and workflows across all your systems and channels.
Welcome to the Resolution Revolution
Zendesk’s embedded AI empowers everyone to reach fast, personalized, and omnichannel resolutions.
Supercharge agent and organizational efficiency with intelligent automations that continuously learn and improve.
Take action on data-driven insights that keep your agents, customers, and employees’ experiences at the forefront.

The Resolution Platform transforms siloed processes into automated, tailored interactions at every touchpoint. Streamline workflows, enhance agent productivity, and boost satisfaction while maintaining trust and resolution quality.
BREAK THROUGH THE AUTOMATION GLASS CEILING

Automate 80%+ of interactions by connecting AI, human agents, and knowledge on one platform. By applying Zendesk AI to unified interaction data, the Resolution Learning Loop™ continually increases automation rates and quality.
Zendesk Agents

Zendesk’s network of AI agents are purpose-built for service. Whether you offer support online or through a contact center, our AI agents handle complex requests and backend tasks so your team can resolve issues faster, with more intelligence and control.
Knowledge graph

Resolution starts with knowledge. AI-powered tools like Knowledge Builder and Knowledge Connectors unify service and external content, creating a smart foundation for AI and human agents to act with confidence.
Actions and integrations
Zendesk seamlessly connects with your backend systems, allowing agents to tackle complex workflows — even when they require action outside of Zendesk.
Measurement & insights

Easily turn insight into action with intuitive dashboards and AI-powered recommendations, no complex setup required. Zendesk AI highlights trends and patterns so you can confidently take action across channels.
Governance & control

Security, privacy, and compliance are essential to establishing trust. That's why Zendesk is built to meet global compliance requirements and safeguard every interaction — so you can confidently scale with peace of mind.
Productivity increase (Nordics)
CSAT

“Ultimately, we want to get to the point of a holistic global digital customer journey. With Zendesk as the foundation and the various apps and integrations such as AI sitting on top of that, we are getting closer and closer to achieving that.”
Steven Franklin
Head of Global Customer Services at Siemens Financial Services
